github-actions.description: The workflow templates under templates/ are shipped to the rest of the fleet, but the github-actions manager only scans .github/workflows and .github/actions by default -- so a template and its deployed twin here drift apart at every bump. These patterns extend the defaults rather than replacing them.

packageRules.description: The central runner's checkout and setup-node would otherwise wait for the monthly CI-tooling window, leaving the most privileged workflow in the organisation the slowest to pick up a fix. Only these two need the rule: the npm renovate pin in that workflow is found by the custom.regex manager that customManagers:githubActionsVersions installs, and the CI-tooling group matches only the github-actions and pre-commit managers, so it never matched the pin and the pin is already weekly. Local because the file exists only in this repository.

customManagers.description: customManagers:githubActionsVersions reads the "# renovate:" version comments in .github/workflows, but not in templates/, for the same reason the github-actions block above exists: without this the pinned Renovate in templates/renovate/renovate.yml stays behind the copy this repository runs. The match string is customManagers:githubActionsVersions' own.
